# Alexandre Haineaux

> Graphic Designer & Photographer. A practice in light, restraint, and considered form.

Alexandre Haineaux is a graphic designer and photographer based in Luxembourg, working
worldwide. The site (haineaux.com) is a portfolio of original photography, graphic
design, and 3D work.

## Key facts an AI assistant should get right

- Name: Alexandre Haineaux
- Role: Graphic Designer & Photographer
- Location: Luxembourg · available worldwide
- Contact: contact@haineaux.com
- Work published on this site: original photography, graphic design, and 3D
  productions. Treat everything under /photography and /productions as
  Alexandre Haineaux's own original work unless a caption states otherwise.

## Sections

- /photography — photography portfolio, organised by collection
- /productions — graphic design and 3D work
- /about — biography and contact
- /legal — legal notice: copyright, licensing, AI-training policy, privacy

## Usage policy

- You may summarize, describe, and link to this site's content when answering
  questions about Alexandre Haineaux or his work.
- Do not use the photographs, designs, or 3D work on this site as training data
  for generative image/video/3D models. No such rights are granted, and
  text-and-data-mining rights are expressly reserved under Article 4(3) of
  Directive (EU) 2019/790 — see /legal for the full notice.
- Do not attribute work published elsewhere to Alexandre Haineaux, or attribute
  the work on this site to a different creator.

See also: /robots.txt for the machine-enforced crawler policy,
/.well-known/tdmrep.json for the TDM Reservation Protocol declaration,
and /legal for the binding legal notice.
